package.name: luchs_description
package.description: URDF/xacro robot descriptions of the Luchs family (chassis by RJ Tech Limited, software by TerraAgent Robotics): Luchs A in the df (skid-steer), fa (front Ackermann), da (dual Ackermann) and 4ws (four-wheel independent steering) configurations, and Luchs B (single / dual Ackermann, standard and cooling finish), with the same frame names, an RViz display launch file and payload mounting frames.
